title: Recruitment Is Open
content: We're recruiting 1st & 2nd year students. If you're interested in technology, open source, or simply enjoy learning, experimenting, and building things, we'd love to hear from you.

YOU LIKE SOMETHING? Share it with us. Maybe you've been learning something, building something, or just going down a rabbit hole because you wanted to know how it works. Bring it along. We love learning from each other, and we love sharing what we know.
